claim: NVIDIA and Palantir are deploying ontology-grounded AI inside NVIDIA's own supply chain.
verifiedFacts: NVIDIA and Palantir announced a stack combining Foundry/AIP, Palantir Ontology and NVIDIA Nemotron models, first deployed within NVIDIA's supply chain.
inference: Knowledge graphs become commercially stronger when linked to operational entities, constraints, decisions and owned data rather than passive semantic maps.
Consultancy: operational ontology and decision-lineage prototypes.
Disposition: Seed Loom CORE; Project Constellation PRODUCTIZE; Agent Runtime INCUBATE.
significance: A major supplier is using its own operations as the first proving ground for ontology-grounded AI.
assumptions: Ontology grounding materially contributes to operational value.
knownLimitations: No independent ROI, reliability or decision-quality measurements were published.
